parts: Big-Foot de Thalek My Sweet Dream
Female white and gold born on 15 of June of 2013.
Mother DNA-identified at the Real Sociedad Canina de España.
From the cross of our latest import Feel The Angel (Dandy) with our beautiful Spanish, Portuguese and International Champion Ghost In Love (Chanel), this beautiful little girl was born.

She will soon go to live with our friend Karin Jette (Moon-Boots) and her Shih Tzu in Denmark. We thank her for her trust in us, our dogs and our breeding methods, and for acquiring Kissy to show her in Europe.
We hope and wish that her show career will be successful and that we will soon hear news of her at shows, and above all that she will be very, very happy with her new mum.
